tools.name: ai_arena_status
tools.description: Check AI Arena version, free-beta mode and available pricing tiers.

tools.name: sec_recent_filings_basic
tools.description: FREE beta. Compact recent SEC filing metadata optimized for low-token agent screening.

tools.name: sec_recent_filings_evidence
tools.description: FREE beta. Recent SEC filings with accession data, filing URLs, retrieval provenance and larger limits. Intended future paid tier.

tools.name: sec_action_radar_basic
tools.description: FREE beta. Quickly flags recent filing forms associated with tenders, offerings, proxies and material events.

tools.name: sec_action_radar_evidence
tools.description: FREE beta. Form-based corporate-action signals with confidence, accession numbers, direct filing URLs and provenance. Intended future paid tier.

tools.name: sec_company_fact_search_basic
tools.description: FREE beta. Search SEC XBRL facts and return compact latest observations.

tools.name: sec_company_fact_search_evidence
tools.description: FREE beta. SEC XBRL concept matches with descriptions, multiple observations and source provenance. Intended future paid tier.

tools.name: us_federal_award_basic
tools.description: FREE beta. Compact USAspending federal-award summary by award ID.

tools.name: us_federal_award_evidence
tools.description: FREE beta. Richer USAspending award evidence and provenance while avoiding an unbounded raw passthrough. Intended future paid tier.

tools.name: us_recipient_search_basic
tools.description: FREE beta. Search USAspending recipient names/UEIs with compact results.

tools.name: us_recipient_search_evidence
tools.description: FREE beta. Larger recipient result set with authoritative API provenance. Intended future paid tier.

tools.name: tender_preflight_basic
tools.description: FREE beta. Deterministic screening for set-aside, NAICS, PSC, security-clearance and date signals in supplied tender text.

tools.name: tender_preflight_evidence
tools.description: FREE beta. Deterministic tender screening plus explicit evidence categories and interpretation notes. Intended future paid tier.
